scope: One VQ weight-compression candidate for action-conditioned DINO-WM Wall; no model or experiment run in this subtask.
model_dispatch: gpt-5.6-luna at xhigh is the requested dispatch parameter; runtime introspection is unavailable, so no stronger identity claim is made.

anchor.planner_score_rule: Call reproduction/dino-wm-wall/source/planning/objectives.py create_objective_fn(alpha, base, mode) directly through the same objective_fn path as CEMPlanner; do not substitute a temporal-average latent distance.
anchor.source_default_distinction: The source default opt_steps=10 is not the candidate SCREEN; CEM5 is the existing screen handoff anchor.

claim_to_test: At one actual-byte ceiling and fixed VPTQ/AQLM-compatible group map, codebook-only entry fitting driven by paired Q predicted rollouts, the unchanged planner score J, and an auxiliary goal-anchored off-diagonal unnormalized Gram B can add held-out planner fidelity, with the effect depending on shared VQ codeword coupling.
formal_checks: Fixed action probes are inputs; the Gram must be recomputed from Q predicted rollout outputs.
Use an absolute same-coordinate auxiliary representation anchor and direct original objective_fn score J; do not treat centered Gram invariance as planner invariance.
Distinguish unnormalized B diagonal (||u||^2) from cosine G diagonal (near 1); off-diagonal is the only relation loss.
First pilot fixes indices and updates only codebook entries; no per-vector full-rollout search.
All variants use a common byte ceiling, but report actual bytes, metadata/codebook/index breakdown and slack; FP32 is not a same-byte compressed variant.
Check whether the effect is just ordinary RKD-style relation matching or QATMA/TPSD (phase0 CR-QAT label) pairwise-similarity quantization.

data_and_units: CAL fits codebook entries only; DEV chooses whether to retain a preregistered positive relation coefficient; TEST confirms one frozen map. Split by episode/initial state; single Wall environment, no task-disjoint claim. Quantizer-fit seeds are units; frames, horizons, action probes and candidate pairs are not independent n. Use common random numbers and paired initial states; at least two fit seeds, no significance/power claim.
stop_conditions: Off-diagonal does not improve held-out action-neighborhood/horizon geometry and original planner first action/return beyond L_abs and local-MSE at the byte ceiling.
Scalar or independent-codebook matches the shared-codebook variant.
Codebook updates did not use Q predicted rollouts, or required actual bytes exceed ceiling.
Only intermediate geometry improves without planner endpoint.
resource_boundary: No model, experiment, SSH/PBS, download, native kernel or cluster submission was performed. Future heavy I/O/model loading/compute requires real PBS_JOBID, non-login hostname and allocation validation. Planning cap is 8-16 A100-hours only, not measured; 40GB conservative and 80GB optional; no paid API budget assumed.

review_questions: Is the candidate mathematically distinguishable from ordinary RKD-style VQ or QATMA/TPSD under the same paired outputs and goal anchor?
Does original objective_fn J provide the only planner-score anchor while B is clearly auxiliary?
Is fixed-index/codebook-only fitting feasible under the stated batches and A100 cap?
Does shared codeword coupling have an independently testable role after scalar and independent-codebook controls?
Should this be retained as a narrow conditional domain-adaptation hypothesis or abandoned before pilot?
final_fit_contract: Freeze all indices. Backpropagate L_TR directly through gather and Q rollout into shared codebook entries with Adam; no STE or closed-form least-squares claim. At most 200 optimizer steps per fit, K<=8 paired probes per batch and H=5, at least two fit seeds. Freeze a common fit-step/data budget after single-A100-40GB forward/backward smoke so collection, all required controls, fits, evaluation and failures fit <=16 allocated GPU-hours. If the minimum fair workload cannot fit or optimize meaningfully, label resource/optimization-inconclusive; no per-vector rollout index search.
